messages.label: Step 0 (listening_phase1) progress trigger — advances to listening_phase2. Cond: service_id == 0xFFFF and sd_entry_count >= 1 and sd_entries[0].type == 0x01 and sd_entries[0].service_id == expected.service_id
Step 1 (listening_phase2) progress trigger — advances to listening_phase3. Cond: service_id == expected.service_id and method_id == 0x0040 and message_type == 0x80
Step 2 (listening_phase3) progress trigger — advances to listening_phase4. Cond: service_id == expected.service_id and method_id == 0x0042 and message_type == 0x80 and payload_byte0 == 0x55
Step 3 (listening_phase4) pass trigger — transitions to pass. Cond: service_id == expected.service_id and method_id == 0x0040 and message_type == 0x80 and payload_byte0 == 0x55
